objective: Review the direct-launch handoff fixture implementation and decide whether the chain may move to defining a real handoff run boundary without claiming execution from the native path yet.

review_decision.reason: The implementation adds a metadata-only readiness fixture. It validates the existing native-invocation fixture output, requires explicit reviewed sidecar context, preserves the pulp_ita_mha 64x1 scope, names the existing sidecar launcher entrypoint only as a future handoff target, and records that sidecar launch and compare remain unreached from the native path.
review_decision.weakest_point: This still does not prove direct Verilator sidecar execution. The fixture records handoff readiness but does not call the sidecar launcher, materialize a stage plan, run coverage-output compare, or measure timing. The next gate must define the exact run boundary before any execution attempt.
accepted_because: the primary entrypoint is define_direct_launch_handoff_fixture in the existing native-invocation fixture module
the output contract keeps sidecar_launch_reached_from_native_path false
execution_performed, measurement_performed, timing_measured, runtime_or_abi_changed, and automatic_gpu_allocation_used remain false
the implementation remains scoped to pulp_ita_mha 64x1 and config/slice_launch_templates/pulp_ita_mha.json
the fixture keeps generated command text and fixture metadata non-authoritative

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_direct_command_path_native_invocation_direct_launch_handoff_run_boundary_gate
must_define: the minimal real handoff run preconditions from a Verilator-facing parse result to sidecar launcher invocation
which command output words are compared for coverage-output equivalence after the sidecar path runs
how direct_launch_handoff_failure, sidecar_stage_failure, and compare_failure remain distinguishable
which files may be generated under reports/ or artifacts/ if a later run gate executes
must_not_define: arbitrary RTL or arbitrary filelist support
raw full-state equality as the acceptance policy

non_claims: reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
